conclusion: No live-engine adoption. Finite proposal/weight correctness and estimator diagnostics only; inspect finite exact BR gaps and independent fixed-response intervals separately. Exact finite-game BR is not nine-player MTT BR.
limitations: Proposal uses enumerated 24-world chance support. Full-deck proposal feasibility/cost is unverified.
Same row-value lookup budget excludes proposal and exact-oracle preprocessing; not a wall-clock speed comparison.
Selection is separate from fit; final holdout unused for decisions.
Repeated budgets reuse stream seeds and are correlated, not nine independent repetitions.
Ideal-IID intervals are conservative; deterministic PRNG is not true IID.
Frozen artificial policy, three seats/four pair ranks/known board; no general GTO or production-range inference.
